definitions.explanation: To show happiness for a special occasion or achievement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{祝|いわ}う。
⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{祝|いわ}って⟦{乾杯|かんぱい}しましょう→乾杯：00176_kanpai⟧。
⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{祝|いわ}います。

notes:
{祝|いわ}う is a godan verb meaning to celebrate an occasion or congratulate someone on an achievement.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pattern: ～を{祝|いわ}う (to celebrate something)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {誕生日|たんじょうび}を{祝|いわ}う: to celebrate a birthday
- {結婚|けっこん}を{祝|いわ}う: to celebrate a marriage
- {合格|ごうかく}を{祝|いわ}う: to celebrate passing an exam
- {成功|せいこう}を{祝|いわ}う: to celebrate a success
- {新年|しんねん}を{祝|いわ}う: to celebrate the new year

RELATED WORDS:
- お{祝|いわ}い: celebration; congratulatory gift (noun form with honorific お)
- {祝日|しゅくじつ}: national holiday
- {祝|しゅく}{福|ふく}: blessing, benediction

NOTE:
お{祝|いわ}いを{言|い}う means to offer congratulations. お{祝|いわ}い can also refer to the gift or money given on a celebratory occasion.
